name: app-pastel-pink-healthy-eating-tracker-two-screens
title: Pastel Pink Healthy-Eating Tracker
whatItIs: Two phones on a grey field: a home screen with a greeting, macro cards with colored icon dots (calories, protein, carbs) and meal tiles, and a second screen with pill-shaped daily bars and a grid of macro cards.
whatItMeans: Pastel pink with white cards and small saturated icons feels gentle and encouraging rather than clinical.
techniques: Icon dots in yellow, blue, green as category codes
Tall pill bars as a calendar-style chart with a smiley on the best day
Two-tone greeting where the question is in black

vocabulary.definition: A small card showing one nutrient's progress.
A header with muted name line and bold question.
